t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will show up in pairs. Each gnome in the pair will lead you to a different forest. The orange, yellow, red blue gnomes will lead to a bright forest with a red basket and the others will lead to a dark forest with a yellow basket. You need to try and gather as many mushrooms as you can and remember with forest leads to the highest mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The aim is to gather as many mushrooms as you can. To do this I would mostly pick the gnomes that lead to the dark forest with the yellow basket, as this usually gives more mushrooms. The brown, yellow, pink and purple gnomes lead to the dark forest. The blue, green, red and orange gnomes lead to the bright forest with a red basket.
